scope: Full public Next Link prefetch only after pointer/focus intent, at most two chapter destinations.
Data Saver and 2G guards at both warm intent and rendered Link prefetch state.
Native links keep existing icon styling, disabled state, focus, labels and navigation lock.
Footer and toolbar share the warm budget; private preview never enables speculative routes.
tests: Completed route data was observed in a clone of the RSC response stream; navigation then blocked any new RSC/document request and retained the page boot token.
Data Saver and 2G suppress metadata/route warming; returning to 4G permits it; repeated focus stays at two metadata lookups.
Disabled previous link has tabindex=-1 and does not navigate on Enter.
Auto-hide, independent regions, keyboard focus, settings, double gestures, Back/reload, progress and image preload stability regressions.
investigation: Existing warm prepared the first image but no page RSC; router.prefetch default prepared a partial route and still required a server request at navigation. The final implementation uses documented Link prefetch=true.
Some Chromium mobile RSC streams did not emit transport completion in time despite usable data. The final test observes delivered component props and still requires zero post-click server requests.
Two host ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE failures occurred before app load; isolated retries passed. No Windows/network settings were changed.
limitations: These are individual prepared-cache lab samples, not a general latency/FPS guarantee.
On touch devices, a tap before prefetch completes can still wait for the server.
No schema, content, original media or permissions were changed.
